summary: Compañía Cervecerías Unidas (CCU) filed a Form 6-K disclosing its acquisition of Nestlé's 49.9% stake in Aguas CCU-Nestlé for ~CLP 164,597 million, implying a 100% enterprise value of ~CLP 322,377 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis. The SPA was executed June 5, 2026, following unanimous board approval on May 6, 2026. No advisors or recommendation were mentioned. The transaction makes CCU the 100% owner of the water subsidiary; price is subject to customary adjustments. The deal closed same-day; watch for future financial impact disclosures and continuing commercial distribution agreement with Nestlé.
